name: draw-icons
title: Draw Icons
description: Designs and generates a custom SVG icon set matched to the product's visual identity: a per-project icons.yaml DNA (corners, caps, grid, stroke), shared geometry parts, and a bundled CLI that lints, renders and checks every icon at real pixel sizes before wiring the built SVGs into the UI.
why: The icon-generation job done as a system rather than one-off drawings: strict shared rules plus rendered proof at 16px. Complements kubai-icons (a ready-made library, link-only here) by drawing icons that do not exist in any pack. Scripts reviewed: local Node CLI, no network or credential access; needs a one-time npm install of yaml and a prebuilt SVG renderer.
